goal: Remove an obsolete configuration option for writing legacy un-obfuscated mempool dumps
Cleans up maintenance debt after releases that required the fallback reached end of life
agreement: Resolved objection on preserving test coverage for reading legacy mempool files (maflcko)
Support because users needing legacy dump files can still use older releases (maflcko)
